rows.text: “For 2026, we project revenue of $1.26 billion to $1.29 billion and earnings per share of $(5.08) to $(4.98) with adjusted EPS of $0.55 to $0.65,” said Chelsea Lantz, interim chief financial officer. “For the fourth quarter, we project revenue between $310 million and $340 million, with earnings per share in the range of $0.05 to $0.15 or $0.11 to $0.21 on an adjusted basis.”
